

// package main




fn identity<T>( value: T) -> (T) {
    
        

return value;



    
}
fn borrow<'a>( value: &'a u8) -> (&'a u8) {
    
        

return value;



    
}
fn clone_value<'a, T: Clone + 'a>( value: &'a T) -> (T) {
    
        

return value.clone();



    
}
fn through_closure<T>( value: T) -> (T) {
    
        
let pass = |item: T| -> (T) {
  
    

return item;



  
}
;


let result = pass(value)
;



return result;



    
}
fn plain( ) -> (u8) {
    
        

return 9u8;



    
}
fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let owner = 7u8;



let first = identity::<u8>(owner)
;


let second = borrow(&owner)
;


let third = clone_value::<u8>(&owner)
;


let fourth = through_closure::<u16>(11u16)
;


let fifth = plain()
;



let _: u8 = first; let _: &u8 = second; let _: u8 = third; let _: u16 = fourth; let _: u8 = fifth; assert_eq!(owner, 7);



    
}
